svg.text: QUAD · micro quadcopter flight controller · rev A
USB-C 5 V → TP4054 charges the 1S LiPo at 260 mA (R16 = 3.3 k, datasheet formula 1) · TPS63001 buck-boost makes 3.3 V from VBAT · ESP32-S3 drives four brushed motors through AO3400A low-side switches
PWM0-3 → motors M0 FR · M1 BR · M2 BL · M3 FL (20 kHz, high = on)
I2C SDA · SCL → BMI323 at 0x68 (SDO low; CSB high = I2C)
UART0 pads TP1 · TP2 on the back (TP3 = GND)
bulk at the connector · C11, C12 at the motor rails · C6 at the converter
EN on VINA: always on · PS/SYNC low: power-save mode
R18 + C9: damped VBUS bypass against hot-plug spikes · CHRG low (LED2 on) while charging
low-side switch per motor: R1-R4 limit the gate current, R5-R8 hold the gates low while the ESP32 boots, D1-D4 clamp the motor's flyback
